d:
Bihar ki aadhyatmik virasat ab ek naee yatra-kahani likh rahi hai.
Ek pahchan jo itihas se aage barhkar uski aastha, sanskriti aur jivant paranpraon se jurti hai. bihar ka shiv sarkit isi soch ki khubsurat tasvir hai.
Yah bhagvan shiv se jure vividh dharmik sthalon aur unse juri sanskritik smritiyon ko ek vyapak yatra-path men dekhne ka avsar deti hai.
Is yatra ki khasiyat keval iski dharmik mahatta nahin hai. raste men milne vali prakriti, sthaniy paranpraen, lokvishvas, utsavon ki raunak aur sadiyon purani virasat ise ek purn sanskritik anubhav banati hai.
